summary: This topic covers the process of defining new subjects within the ERP system, including setting up the subject name, a unique code, and an assessment model. It also explains how to optionally map subjects to specific classes and the implications of editing subjects before and after they are mapped.
steps: Enter a 'unique code' for the subject (e.g., ENG).
Select an 'Assessment Model' (e.g., Scholastic Subject, Course Scholastic Subject).
Optionally, select specific classes if the subject should only be available for mapping in those classes.
business_rules: The subject code is a mandatory field and must be unique.
The subject code defines the subject itself, not the class it is taught in.
Course scholastic subjects or discipline subjects use grading criteria (teachers enter grades).
important_notes: A subject can be edited (name, code, assessment model) if it has only been created and not yet mapped to any class.
Once a subject has been added to a class mapping, its name cannot be changed from the subject definition; only its display name can be altered within the mapping.
questions: How do I add a new subject to the ERP system?
What is the purpose of the unique subject code?
Can I define a subject that is only visible for specific classes?
What are the different assessment models available for subjects?
Is it possible to edit a subject's details after it has been created?
